welcome_p1: Navia taswira ce da kake bincika ta hanyar taɓawa. Ja yatsa a kan taswirar ka ji tituna, shaguna, tashoshin bas da mashigai da ke ƙarƙashinsa.
welcome_p2: Navia ƙarin taimako ne kawai. Koyaushe ka fara amfani da sandarka, karen jagora ko wata hanya mai aminci.
welcome_q: Kana amfani da mai karanta allo (TalkBack ko VoiceOver)?
mode_sr_btn: Eh, ina amfani da mai karanta allo
mode_voice_btn: A'a, Navia ta yi magana da kanta
welcome_small: Za ka iya canza wannan daga baya a Saituna. Cikakkiyar manhajar Android mai ƙarin fasali tana kan {link}.
tap_sr: Kana amfani da TalkBack ko VoiceOver? Koma yanayin mai karanta allo
sound_hint: Yi amfani da belun kunne. Kana tsaye a wannan wuri, kana fuskantar {dir}.
mode_sr_opt: Mai karanta allo na yana magana (TalkBack ko VoiceOver)
labels_opt: Nuna sunaye a kan taswirar da aka zana
detail_opt: Haɗa lambobin gidaje da adiresoshin gine-gine
offline_btn: Ajiye wannan yanki don amfani ba tare da intanet ba
install_btn: Ƙara Navia Web zuwa allon gida
install_android: Shigar da manhajar Android daga Google Play
ios_intro: A iPhone da iPad, a cikin Safari:
ios_1: Zaɓi maɓallin Share. Yana kan sandar kayan aiki a ƙasan allo (a iPad a sama).
ios_2: A cikin jerin, zaɓi “Add to Home Screen”. Wataƙila sai ka fara gungurawa ƙasa ko zaɓar “More”.
ios_note: Daga nan Navia za ta buɗe daga allon gida kamar manhaja, ba tare da sandunan burauza ba.
and_1: Zaɓi “More options”, maɓallin menu a sama dama.
and_2: Zaɓi “Add to Home screen” ko “Install app”, sannan “Install”.
and_note: A Samsung Internet: Menu, sannan “Add page to”, sannan “Home screen”. A Firefox: Menu, sannan “Install”.
share_title: Kana son Navia? Gaya wa wasu!
share_msg: Kana so ka raba Navia Web da wasu? Za ka iya aika hanyar haɗin ta imel, WhatsApp ko kowace manhaja ga aboki, ɗan uwa ko duk wanda zai amfana da taswirar da ake iya taɓawa da ji.
help_1: Ja yatsa ɗaya a kan taswirar. Za ka ji abin da ke ƙarƙashinsa. Da mai karanta allo, ana karanta taswirar yayin da kake bincike ta taɓawa.
help_2: Taɓa wuri sau biyu (mai karanta allo) ko ka taɓa ka riƙe (ba tare da mai karanta allo ba) don a jagorance ka zuwa can, ka ji sautukansa ko ka sa tsakiyar taswira a can.
help_3: Yi amfani da Arewa, Kudu, Yamma da Gabas don matsar da taswira, da ƙara ko rage girma don ganin ƙari ko ƙasa.
help_4: Ba tare da mai karanta allo ba za ka iya matsar da taswira da yatsu biyu ka matse su don canza girma.
help_5: Ana bayar da hanyoyi kamar matsayin agogo: ƙarfe 12 shi ne kai tsaye gaba, ko arewa idan babu kamfas.
help_6: Bayanan taswira © masu ba da gudummawa ga OpenStreetMap. Navia ƙarin taimako ne kawai.
place_dist: Mita {d} daga gare ka a hanyar ƙarfe {h}
load_failed: Ba a iya loda wani ɓangare na taswira ba. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
offline_missing: Babu intanet: ba a ajiye wannan yanki ba.
loading: Ana loda taswirar wannan yanki. A karon farko zai iya ɗaukar har minti ɗaya.
no_geo: Babu wurin da kake a wannan burauza.
geo_denied: An ƙi izinin wuri. Maimakon haka za ka iya neman wani wuri.
geo_unavailable: Ba a samun wurin da kake a yanzu.
centered_you: An sa tsakiyar taswira a wurin da kake. {center}
walk_on: Za a sanar da wurare yayin da kake tafiya, muddin wannan shafi a buɗe yake.
offline_start: Ana ajiye kusan kilomita 10 da 10 a kewayen tsakiyar taswira. Zai iya ɗaukar 'yan mintuna.
offline_progress: Ana ajiyewa don amfani ba tare da intanet ba: {done} cikin {total}
offline_partial: An ajiye, amma ɓangarori {n} sun gaza. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
offline_done: An ajiye yankin. Yanzu yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba.
share_web_title: Navia Web – taswirar da za ka iya taɓawa
share_web_text: Gano Navia Web, taswirar da za ka iya taɓawa! Ja yatsanka a kan allo ka ji tituna, shaguna da wuraren da ke ƙarƙashinsa. Cikakkiyar mai sauƙin amfani, an yi ta don makafi da masu raunin gani, kuma tana da daɗi ga kowa. Kyauta a burauza a iPhone da Android:
share_android_title: Navia – taswirar da za ka iya taɓawa
share_android_text: Gano Navia, taswirar da za ka iya taɓawa! Ja yatsanka a kan allo ka ji tituna, shaguna da wuraren da ke ƙarƙashinsa. Cikakkiyar mai sauƙin amfani, an yi ta don makafi da masu raunin gani, kuma tana da daɗi ga kowa. Kyauta a Google Play:
link_copied: An kwafi hanyar haɗi. Liƙa ta a imel ko saƙo.
installed: An ƙara Navia zuwa allon gidanka.
quiet: Wuri mai natsuwa: ba a sami tushen sauti a kusa ba.
ready_voice: Navia a shirye take. Ja yatsa a kan taswira.
ready_sr: Navia a shirye take. Bincika taswira ta hanyar taɓawa. Maɓallan suna ƙarƙashin taswira.
sr_mode: Yanayin mai karanta allo. Bincika taswira ta hanyar taɓawa. Taɓa wuri sau biyu don zaɓuɓɓuka.
allow_location: Ba da izinin wuri, ko yi amfani da Nema don zaɓar wuri.
landing_q: Ta yaya kake so ka yi amfani da Navia?
landing_app_note: Manhajar tana da ƙarin fasali, kamar sanarwa yayin da allo a kashe yake.
landing_web: Yi amfani da Navia Web a wannan burauza
install_prompt_title: Ka shigar da Navia Web a wayarka?
install_prompt_msg: Ƙara Navia Web zuwa allon gida. Daga nan za ta buɗe kamar manhaja, da taɓawa ɗaya kuma ba tare da sandunan burauza ba.
walk_ask_title: A sanar da wurare yayin da kake tafiya?
walk_ask_msg: Navia za ta iya gaya maka wuraren da kake wucewa yayin tafiya, muddin wannan shafi a buɗe yake. Tana yin shiru idan ba ka motsi. Za ka iya canza wannan daga baya a Saituna.
